results.question: How many days of paid annual leave do employees get?
results.answer:
Every full-time employee receives **28 days of paid annual leave** per calendar
year, in addition to public holidays in their country of residence. [1]

results.question: How many unused leave days can be carried into the next year, and when do they expire?
results.answer: Up to **five unused days** may be carried into the next calendar year. [1]

results.question: What is the one-time home office budget for a new employee?
results.answer:
On top of that, there is a one-time home office
budget of **EUR 1,200**, which can be spent on a desk, chair, monitor, lighting,
or anything else that improves the workspace. [1]

results.question: How many weeks of fully paid parental leave are offered to new parents?
results.answer:
Northwind Labs offers 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to all new parents
regardless of gender, on top of any statutory entitlement in the employee's
country. [1]

results.question: What is the daily core overlap window for meetings?
results.answer:
Northwind Labs runs on asynchronous work with a daily core overlap window of
10:00–14:00 in each employee's local time zone. [1]

results.question: What does the Lumen Team plan cost per month?
results.answer:
| Plan | Price | Included ingest | Retention | Seats |
| ---------- | ---------- | --------------- | --------- | --------- |
| Starter | USD 49 | 20 GB / month | 7 days | 3 |
| Team | USD 199 | 150 GB / month | 30 days | 15 |
| Enterprise | Custom | Negotiated | Up to 1 year | Unlimited | [1]

results.question: What is the ingest overage charge per GB on the Starter and Team plans?
results.answer: Overage on the Starter and Team plans is billed at **USD 0.40 per GB**. [1]

results.question: What is the maximum size of a single log line accepted by the ingest API?
results.answer:
A single log line may not exceed 256 KB; longer lines
are truncated and tagged with `lumen.truncated=true`. [1]

results.question: What is the first response target for a Sev-1 issue on the Enterprise support plan?
results.answer:
| Plan | First response target | Channels |
| ---------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| Starter | 2 business days | Email |
| Team | 8 business hours | Email, chat |
| Enterprise | 1 hour for Sev-1 | Email, chat, phone, shared Slack | [1]

results.question: How often are Lumen alert rules evaluated by default?
results.answer:
It ingests structured application
logs, indexes them for full-text and field search, and evaluates alert rules
against the stream as it arrives. [1]

results.question: How long are audit logs retained?
results.answer:
Audit logs covering authentication,
permission changes, and data exports are retained for 400 days. [1]

results.question: Within how long are confirmed incidents affecting customer data reported to customers?
results.answer:
Confirmed incidents affecting customer
data are reported to affected customers within **72 hours** of confirmation,
with a written post-incident review published within 14 days. [1]

results.question: How often are the encryption keys used for data at rest rotated?
results.answer:

using keys held in a managed key service, rotated every 90 days. [1]
